title: Brass bands at funerals
summary: Adams describes draped horses and brass bands at funerals but never followed them out of respect.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

brass bands and uh they had old time horses with the horses with the black uh I don't know what you call it all draped down over the horses you know like a mosquito ball all black you know knitted work all the time of the horses had the old brass lamps on each side of the horse old time just like you see me in that cell and now.
